Department of Education
The Department of Education established in the year 2020, is one of the fifth Departments of Govt Model College, Borkhola. The major focus of the Department is to provide the dissemination and advancement of knowledge by translating educational thoughts, innovative ideas and values in order to develop the creativity and critical eye among the students. In order to realise the above noble objectives, the Department strictly follow the learner-centered as well as joyful learning approach and is trying to train the students in the dynamic aspects in order to compete with the contemporary scenario.
Vision and Mission
To cultivate student engagement and motivation.
To promote high aspiration in learning.
To accredit and certify experiential and work based learning.
To improve the all round development of students.
To strengthen meaningful and reciprocal links between the education and employment.
